name: Colombian Caribbean
about: Dry season Dec–Apr is best for beaches and Cartagena's walled city; this coast sits south of the main Caribbean hurricane belt, so tropical storms are a much smaller risk here than elsewhere in the Caribbean.
overview: Cartagena's UNESCO-listed colonial walled city, Tayrona National Park, and the multi-day trek to the Lost City — Colombia's Caribbean coast, warm and historic.
costOverview: Street food and local transport are cheap even in touristy Cartagena — the walled city's boutique hotels and the multi-day Lost City trek are where the real spending happens.
